issues.description: Default extraction requires data/stories files that are absent, so the advertised demo pipeline fails from a fresh checkout.
generate-stories tries to read an existing manifest before generation, preventing dataset bootstrap in an empty stories directory.
README advertises runnable make demo/extract commands, but the required story dataset is not included or bootstrapable.
Heavy ML dependencies use only lower bounds, making installs non-reproducible and vulnerable to upstream API breakage.
Model loading uses the newer dtype keyword while declaring compatibility with transformers>=4.42, which can break older allowed versions.
HTTP story generation has no timeout or response-status handling, so it can hang indefinitely or fail with opaque errors.
Story loading ignores manifest contents and does not validate that requested emotions/topics match the dataset.
PCA divides by total variance without a zero-variance guard, producing NaNs on degenerate neutral activations.
Steering integration test only checks that scores move, not that movement direction matches the claimed correlation behavior.
Committed tiny output shows negative correlation-vs-shift despite README claiming shift should track correlation.
Committed baseline ranks harmful-adjacent activities above positive ones, contradicting the documented expected interpretation.
Repo contains ignored generated directories emovec.egg-info and outputs, creating stale artifact risk.
requirements.txt mixes runtime and dev dependencies and duplicates unpinned dependency policy from pyproject.
Package import mutates process-wide environment variables, which can surprise embedding applications and tests.
